title: DoubleAgents: Human-Agent Alignment in a Socially Embedded Workflow
abstract: arXiv:2509.12626v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Aligning agentic AI with user intent is critical for delegating complex, socially embedded tasks, yet user preferences are often implicit, evolving, and difficult to specify upfront. We present DoubleAgents, a system for human-agent alignment in coordination tasks, grounded in distributed cognition. DoubleAgents integrates three components: (1) a coordination agent that maintains state and proposes plans and actions, (2) a dashboard visualization that makes the agent's reasoning legible for user evaluation, and (3) a policy module that transforms user edits into reusable alignment artifacts, including coordination policies, email templates, and stop hooks, which improve system behavior over time. We evaluate DoubleAgents through a two-day in-lab interactive simulation study (n=10), three real-world deployments, and a technical evaluation. translated_title: DoubleAgents：社会嵌入式工作流中的人-智能体对齐
translated_abstract: 将智能体AI与用户意图对齐对于委派复杂的、嵌入社会情境的任务至关重要，但用户偏好往往是隐性的、不断演变的，且难以事先明确指定。我们提出了DoubleAgents，一个基于分布式认知理论的协调任务中人-智能体对齐系统。DoubleAgents集成了三个组件：(1) 一个维护状态并提出计划和行动的协调智能体；(2) 一个仪表板可视化界面，使智能体的推理过程清晰可读，便于用户评估；(3) 一个策略模块，将用户的编辑转化为可复用的对齐工件，包括协调策略、电子邮件模板和停止钩子，从而随时间推移不断改善系统行为。我们通过为期两天的实验室交互式模拟研究（n=10）、三次真实世界部署以及技术评估来评估DoubleAgents。参与者在任务委派方面的舒适度和对DoubleAgents的依赖度均随时间增加。
tldr: 该论文提出了DoubleAgents系统，通过协调智能体、可视化仪表板和策略模块三个组件，将用户编辑转化为可复用的对齐工件（如协调策略、邮件模板和停止钩子），实现了社会嵌入性协调任务中人与智能体的持续动态对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper presents DoubleAgents, a system for human-agent alignment in socially embedded coordination tasks that integrates a coordination agent, a legible dashboard visualization, and a policy module that transforms user edits into reusable alignment artifacts to improve system behavior over time.
